"Huff, huff... That was close.
  If you hadn't come, I'd have
  turned into a monster.

"I came to polish the Pegasus statue,
  and it was suddenly wrapped in evil light.
  It tried to fuse with me by force.

"The statue is said to fuse with a horse
  that has a Pegasus heart and regain
  its true form. Why did it fuse so blindly...

"Anyway, it's dangerous here.
  Let's get away from this statue quickly.

"Grandpa! I couldn't wait any lon-ger,
  so I came! Get it, horse-er?

"Ah, you're my horse! No!
  Don't come this way!
